blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Three plus the quantity x plus seven equals the quantity three plus x, plus seven. Which property does it show?
Read each side from left to right: three, x, seven. The order didn't change.
Only the parentheses moved. Changing the grouping is the associative property.
So the answer is the associative property.
Watch out for these traps. It isn't the commutative property, because the terms stay in the same order. It isn't the distributive property, because everything here is addition.
